tagline: 尼康胶片单反相机，2001 年发布
description: 尼康于2001年推出的胶片单反相机。快门速度CPU-controlled focal plane shutter with speeds 30 - 1/2000 sec.。使用35mm, automatic recognition of DX-coded film speed, speeds from 25 to 5000 ASA。Cross-ranged, five-area autofocus system。

specs.胶片/画幅: 35mm, automatic recognition of DX-coded film speed, speeds from 25 to 5000 ASA
specs.卡口: Nikon F autofocus bayonet, depth of field preview button
specs.快门: CPU-controlled focal plane shutter with speeds 30 - 1/2000 sec.
specs.曝光测光: 3D-six-zone-matrix TTL measuring or center weighted TTL measuring
specs.闪光灯: built-in miniature flash (GN 40), or flash gun on TTL-enhanced hot shoe
specs.英文简介: The Nikon F65; also known as the Nikon N65 in the United States or the Nikon U in Japan is a 35mm entry level SLR camera released in 2001.
